alerts.desc: Reflected XSS found in the 'q' parameter of the /rest/products/search endpoint. User input is echoed back in the response without sanitization.
alerts.solution: Encode all user-controllable output. Use context-aware output encoding and a Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.desc: SQL injection found in the login form 'email' parameter. Error-based and boolean-based payloads confirmed the vulnerability.
alerts.solution: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: No CSP header was found, which reduces protection against XSS and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Implement a strict Content-Security-Policy header appropriate for the application.

alerts.desc: X-Frame-Options header is not set, allowing the page to be framed by other sites.
alerts.solution: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or use CSP frame-ancestors.

alerts.desc: Stack trace or internal error details returned in HTTP response, revealing server-side implementation details.
alerts.solution: Return generic error messages to clients; log detailed errors server-side only.

alerts.desc: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set to 'nosniff', which can allow MIME-type sniffing attacks.
alerts.solution: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.
